node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 K3 independent proof review
node.statement: A fresh independent reviewer outside the producing implementations has replayed and audited the complete load-bearing K3 sub-DAG at pinned commits: the active bad-slope-to-component bridge; full-V4 and negative-coordinate exclusions; positive raw workboards and all remaining route payments; complete source-line, source-cover, and trivial-stabilizer payments; orientation composition; allocation definition; and distinct-slope ledger. The reviewer confirms the active row/partition contract, exact multiplicities, and same-owner chronology and records no unresolved mathematical or custody objection. Review of similarly named experimental packets or self-review by a producing implementation is insufficient.
node.falsifier: A failed replay, digest mismatch, missing dependency, owner/row mismatch, unreviewed load-bearing argument, or unresolved reviewer objection.
